name: When is it better to repair a bathtub versus replacing it?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to repair a bathtub versus replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the extent of the damage and the tub's age. Minor issues like small chips, cracks, or surface discoloration can often be repaired cost-effectively. However, if the tub has significant structural damage, widespread leaks, or extensive mold growth, replacement is usually the more practical and long-term solution. A new tub also allows for aesthetic upgrades and improved functionality that repairs cannot provide.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage like chips or discoloration. Replace if there's significant structural damage, widespread leaks, or if you want aesthetic upgrades.
